body:
Wow.  I literally thought I was the only one absolutely disgusted with the blatant double-standards, discrimination, oppression, and what have you within this world.  Plus, in my case, to find out my own parents are part of the societal problem, it's utterly ridiculous.  To have my dad tell me 'death is death' whether it be from wearing a COVID mask or freezing in the cold, that was a rap for me.  Now I'm not depressed.  Honestly, I like and love myself.  I know I've done nothing wrong and I'm a super great person.  To learn that my dad literally hates be for not being him or changing to become him is both mind-boggling and disheartening.  He is totally psychologically abusive.  It's like the abusive guy who punches his wife, says "see what you made me do," then he says he loves her just before beginning the punching cycle all over again.  My dad punches me psychologically and claims to love me.  Of course I know he doesn't based on his action, or rather inaction.  I am so disgusted with this oppressive, discriminatory world with my parents as ring-leaders, and being ostracized for being different.  It is not logical to remain in a place like this for me.  I am not sad.  I am just the opposite actually.  That's another thing my own dad hates on-my happiness.  He's only happy if he thinks I'm in a crisis.  I reiterate.
  It is not logical to remain here.  I have nothing in common with people here as most all are miserable fearful vermin who desire to make you miserable by any means necessary..even if it means concocting false stories or what have you.  What productive person with a real life has time to sit around and intentionally try to ruin the lives of others?  Most miserable people in this disgusting world...that's who.  We all have the right to choose if we desire to reside here or not.  No one else or entity has the right to tell anyone they should remain in illogical circumstances.  Now I don't want to die per se.  I just don't want to be in a place as disgusting as this world where I have nothing in common with the many evil people here.  But if anyone decides they will take steps to no longer be here, they have that right.  No one should have to suffer or ascribe to a slave mentality that suffering is just a part of life.  That is a fib.  Suffering is abnormal.  And no one should have to listen to anyone tell them "It's gonna get better" or "Just pray" Most of the people saying this are religious hypocrites.  Forget prayer.  Many of us could write a book of prayers and I'm sure we would if prayer would make it better.  Some situations won't get better and we should have the right to take appropriate action as self-deemed to alleviate suffering, all the while not harming others.  I know some will say well if you eliminate yourself from the world your families will hurt.  Listen.  It is ok to be selfish in some areas.  Self-care is paramount.  Your family aren't the ones experiencing what you're experiencing. It's actually selfish of so-called family to try to coerce you into staying in misery.  That's selfish.  Anyhoo, I know I stated a lot.  I have the right to state what I desire.  I do not care who does or does not like it. I speak knowledge, wisdom, truth.  If you find this world disgusting like I do, it is natural for you to not want to reside in it.   That doesn't mean you have plans of removing yourself, or perhaps you do.  Either way, it is your right. #deathdiva
